safetyNotes: Print PRT-01 (96-Well Indexing Deck) and PRT-02/03 (Gantry Uprights) in PETG with 4 perimeters and 35% cubic infill for dimensional stability.
MGN9H rail mounting ledges include a 0.15mm reference shoulder to guarantee X/Y orthogonality without dial-indicator tramming.

steps.title: Step 1: Install Dual-Bay SBS 96-Well Microplate Indexing Deck & Standard SBS 96-Well Flat-Bottom Microplates (2×) & 200µL Tip Rack
steps.note: Rigid base plate featuring two ANSI/SLAS 127.76×85.48mm 96-well plate nests and tip waste chute. Establishes the kinematic datum for both 96-well microplates and anchors the gantry uprights.
steps.description: Rigid base plate featuring two ANSI/SLAS 127.76×85.48mm 96-well plate nests and tip waste chute. Establishes the kinematic datum for both 96-well microplates and anchors the gantry uprights.

steps.title: Step 2: Install Left Y-Axis Portal Upright & NEMA17 Motor Mount & Right Y-Axis Portal Upright & Idler Pulley Tower & M3 Stainless Socket Head Cap Screws & Brass Heat-Set Insert Kit
steps.note: Gusseted left portal column housing the X-axis NEMA17 stepper motor and optical home switch. Supports the left end of the MGN9H X-axis bridge rail and drives the GT2 timing belt.
steps.description: Gusseted left portal column housing the X-axis NEMA17 stepper motor and optical home switch. Supports the left end of the MGN9H X-axis bridge rail and drives the GT2 timing belt.

steps.title: Step 3: Install NEMA 17 Bipolar Stepper Motors 1.8° 42×34mm (3-Pack) & MGN9H 250mm Miniature Stainless Linear Guide Rails + Blocks (×2)
steps.note: Three 1.8° 200-step/rev NEMA17 bipolar stepper motors for X-carriage, Y-deck, and Z-plunger. Drives X/Y gantry positioning and T8 leadscrew pipette dispensing.
steps.description: Three 1.8° 200-step/rev NEMA17 bipolar stepper motors for X-carriage, Y-deck, and Z-plunger. Drives X/Y gantry positioning and T8 leadscrew pipette dispensing.

steps.title: Step 4: Install MGN9H Linear Rail X-Axis Pipette Shuttle Carriage & GT2 6mm Fiberglass Timing Belt (2m) + 20T 5mm Bore Pulleys & Idlers
steps.note: Precision shuttle block that bolts to the MGN9H bearing block with self-locking GT2 belt teeth. Carries the Z-axis pipette assembly along the X-axis linear rail.
steps.description: Precision shuttle block that bolts to the MGN9H bearing block with self-locking GT2 belt teeth. Carries the Z-axis pipette assembly along the X-axis linear rail.

steps.title: Step 5: Install Compliant Z-Axis Micropipette Barrel Clamp & Optical / Micro Limit Switch Homing Sensors with Cables (3-Pack)
steps.note: Quick-release flexure cradle that holds standard 10–200µL single or 8-channel lab micropipettes. Mounts the micropipette vertically to the X-carriage and guides the T8 plunger nut.
steps.description: Quick-release flexure cradle that holds standard 10–200µL single or 8-channel lab micropipettes. Mounts the micropipette vertically to the X-carriage and guides the T8 plunger nut.

steps.title: Step 6: Install T8 Leadscrew Pipette Plunger Actuation Escapement & T8×2mm Pitch Stainless Leadscrew (200mm) + Anti-Backlash Brass Nut
steps.note: Anti-rotation fork mounted on the T8 brass nut that depresses the micropipette thumb plunger. Converts NEMA17 T8 leadscrew rotation into sub-microliter plunger strokes.
steps.description: Anti-rotation fork mounted on the T8 brass nut that depresses the micropipette thumb plunger. Converts NEMA17 T8 leadscrew rotation into sub-microliter plunger strokes.

steps.title: Step 7: Install Snap-Fit Disposable Tip Stripping Fork
steps.note: Bifurcated stripping collar that ejects used 200µL pipette tips into the deck waste chute. Strips disposable tips cleanly at the top of the Z-travel stroke.
steps.description: Bifurcated stripping collar that ejects used 200µL pipette tips into the deck waste chute. Strips disposable tips cleanly at the top of the Z-travel stroke.

steps.title: Step 8: Install Vented GRBL / ESP32 3-Axis Stepper Electronics Housing & ESP32 GRBL 3-Axis CNC Controller Board + 3× TMC2209 Silent Drivers & 12V 3A 36W Regulated DC Power Supply Adapter (5.5×2.1mm)
steps.note: Rear-mounted electronics bay with cooling louvers and M3 standoffs for the ESP32 GRBL board. Encloses and cools the 3-axis ESP32 CNC board and TMC2209 stepper drivers.
steps.description: Rear-mounted electronics bay with cooling louvers and M3 standoffs for the ESP32 GRBL board. Encloses and cools the 3-axis ESP32 CNC board and TMC2209 stepper drivers.
